shortDescription: Hurricane Polo is approaching category 5 strength on the Saffir-Simpson scale as it continues to intensify rapidly, the US National Hurricane Center said on Tuesday.Polo is expected to move slowly off the coast of Mexico during the next couple of days, the advisory added.
